hero.title: Every table closes with the right bill.
hero.lead: Table4All puts QR ordering, the kitchen queue and split payments on a single tab. Owners know exactly what came in. Guests order without waiting for a waiter.

steps.label: One night at a table, from first order to closing

order.title: Guests order from their phone
order.body: Every table has a QR code. Whoever sits down scans it, sees the menu with photos and prices, and sends the order. No flagging down the waiter, no orders taken down wrong.

queue.title: Every order goes to the right queue
queue.body: Draft beer lands in the bar queue, appetizers in the kitchen queue. Whoever prepares marks it ready, whoever serves marks it delivered. Items with no prep go straight to delivery.

price.title: The price is locked when the order is placed
price.body: Happy hour or date-based promotions apply the moment an item is ordered. Happy hour ended at 8 pm, but the beer ordered at 7:42 keeps its promo price. Changed the menu later? The table's bill stays the same.

payments.title: Split the bill, no calculator
payments.body: Everyone pays their share by Pix, card, cash or coupon. The tab shows what has been paid and what is left, and guests see the same number on their phone.

close.title: A table only closes when the bill adds up
close.body: A table can only be closed once payments cover the total. Every closed bill feeds the dashboard: revenue per day, best sellers, average ticket per table and payment methods.

owners.title: For whoever runs the venue
items: Tables, waiters and menus in one place
Separate prep queues for the kitchen, the bar and anything else
Promotions by weekday and time, or by date
Dashboard with revenue, best sellers and payment methods
Print-ready menus with a QR code

guests.title: For whoever sits at the table
items: Scan the QR and you are at the table
Order at your own pace, no hand-raising
Follow what is being prepared and what has arrived
See the total, what has been paid and what each person owes

When the platform covers the processing fee, it gives that fee back out of its own commission on the payment (on Stripe, through Stripe itself; on Mercado Pago, paid to you outside it). A platform coupon's discount beyond the commission is also paid to you outside the provider.

privacy.head: Privacy Policy
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains which personal data Table4All processes, what for, who it is shared with, how long it is kept and how you exercise your rights, under Brazil's General Data Protection Law (Law 13,709/2018, LGPD).

controller.title: Who the controller is
controller.body:
The controller of the data processed by the platform is {{controller}}.

The data protection officer (DPO) is {{dpo}}, who answers data subjects and the National Data Protection Authority (ANPD) at {{dpo_email}}.

Each restaurant that uses Table4All is also a controller of the data of its own service (what was ordered and paid at the venue) and answers for its part.

data.title: What data we process
data.body:
- Account: name, email, password (stored only as a hash), phone (optional), profile picture (optional) and account type.
- Security: two-factor authentication and passkeys, active sessions (IP address, browser and last activity) and sign-in dates.
- At the table: tables you joined, items ordered and notes, payments, waiter calls, messages and reactions in the table chat.
- Online payments: amounts, status and transaction identifiers. Card details are typed straight into Stripe or Mercado Pago; Table4All never receives or stores them.
- Loyalty and coupons: personal coupons and rewards earned at each restaurant.
- Social: comments, reactions and reviews you post on restaurant profiles.
- Restaurants: venue name, contact details, address, map location, pictures, menu and Stripe or Mercado Pago payout account details.
- Staff: name, email and permissions of waiters and staff invited by the restaurant.
- Contact: venue name, email, phone, city and message sent through the contact form.
- Approximate location: only if you allow it in the browser, rounded to about 100 m and used only to sort restaurants by distance. It is not stored.

We do not process sensitive personal data, do not use your data for advertising and do not sell it.

purposes.title: What we use it for and on which legal basis
purposes.body:
- Creating and keeping your account, opening tables, recording orders, splitting and closing the bill: performance of a contract (Art. 7, V).
- Processing online payments, refunds and payouts to restaurants: performance of a contract (Art. 7, V).
- Keeping bills, payments and financial records for the required period: legal obligation (Art. 7, II) and exercise of rights (Art. 7, VI).
- Keeping access logs (IP, date and time): legal obligation under Brazil's Internet Civil Framework (Art. 7, II).
- Protecting accounts and the platform (attempt limits, sessions, fraud prevention): legitimate interest (Art. 7, IX).
- Loyalty program and coupons: performance of a contract (Art. 7, V).
- Comments, reactions and reviews: performance of a contract, when you choose to post (Art. 7, V).
- Sorting restaurants by distance: consent given in the browser (Art. 7, I), which you can withdraw at any time in its settings.
- Answering the contact form: steps prior to a contract, at your request (Art. 7, V).
- Service emails (email confirmation, password reset, invitations): performance of a contract (Art. 7, V).

sharing.title: Who we share it with
sharing.body:
- The restaurant you are at: sees your name, your orders, calls, payments and the table chat, to serve you.
- Other people at the same table: see your name, your orders and your messages in the table chat.
- Stripe and Mercado Pago: process online payments and the restaurants' payout accounts (each restaurant chooses one of them). Stripe also receives your email for the payment; on Mercado Pago, whoever pays signs in or types their own details there.
- Hostinger: hosts the server and the database, in Brazil.
- Resend: sends your account emails (sign-up confirmation, password reset, invitations) and receives your name and email address to do so.
- These providers are processors: they handle the data only to keep the service running, under contract.
- OpenStreetMap (Nominatim): receives only restaurants' public addresses, to find them on the map. No customer data is sent.
- Public authorities: when there is a court order or a legal obligation.

Restaurant profiles, posts and reviews are public, and your comments and reactions on them show your name.

international.title: International transfers
international.body: Some processors, such as Stripe and Resend, may process data outside Brazil. In those cases the transfer follows Art. 33 of the LGPD, with contractual clauses that ensure protection equivalent to Brazilian law.

retention.title: How long we keep it
retention.body:
- Account: while it exists. When you delete your account we erase your profile, messages, comments, reactions, reviews, personal coupons and rewards.
- Financial records (table bills, charged items and payments): for the period set by tax and commercial law, usually 5 years. Once the account is deleted they are no longer linked to you.
- Access logs (IP, date and time): 6 months, as required by the Internet Civil Framework (Law 12,965/2014, Art. 15).
- Table chat and reactions: {{chat_days}} days after the table closes.
- Waiter calls: {{calls_days}} days after they are answered.
- Sign-in links and invitations: a few days after they are used or expire.
- Contact form: {{admission_days}} days after it is answered.
- Temporary posts ("Hoje tem!"): 24 hours.

rights.title: Your rights

cookies.title: Cookies and local storage
cookies.body:
Table4All only uses cookies that are strictly necessary for it to work. We do not use advertising, tracking or third-party analytics cookies.

- table4all-session: keeps you signed in. Lasts while the session is active.
- XSRF-TOKEN: protects forms against forged submissions. Same duration as the session.
- remember_web_*: only if you tick "Remember me" when signing in. Lasts until you sign out.
- locale: the language you picked. 1 year.
- appearance: light or dark theme. 1 year.
- sidebar_state: side menu open or closed. 7 days.

In the browser's local storage we keep only interface preferences, such as language, theme, filters, stories already seen and the dismissed cookie notice.

Because they are needed for the service, these cookies do not depend on consent. You can delete them in your browser settings, but signing in will stop working.

security.title: Security
security.body:
Passwords are stored only as hashes, the connection is encrypted (HTTPS), access to data is limited by account type (customer, staff, restaurant, administrator) and administrators sign in with two-factor authentication. We also limit sign-in and table code attempts.

If a security incident may cause relevant risk or harm, we will notify the ANPD and the people affected, as Art. 48 of the LGPD requires.

children.title: Children and teenagers
children.body: Table4All is meant for people aged {{min_age}} or older. If we learn that an account belongs to someone younger, it will be deleted.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.body: We may update this policy. The date of the current version is at the top of the page and, when a change is relevant, we will let you know by email or on the platform.

terms.head: Terms of Use
terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: These terms govern the use of Table4All, a platform for table management, QR code ordering, prep queues and payments for bars and restaurants. By creating an account or using the platform you agree to them and to the Privacy Policy.

service.title: The service
service.body:
Table4All is run by {{controller}}. The platform connects customers, staff and restaurants: customers open or join a table with its code, order and pay; restaurants manage tables, menu, prep queues and staff.

Table4All does not sell or prepare the products. The sale is made by the restaurant, which answers for the products, prices, service, tax documents and consumer and health rules.

account.title: Your account
account.body:
- To create an account you must be {{min_age}} or older and give truthful information.
- The account is personal. Keep your password safe and tell us if you suspect misuse.
- Waiters and staff join by invitation from the restaurant, which decides what each of them can do.
- Restaurant accounts are created by the Table4All team after a sales contact.

customers.title: Use by customers
customers.body:
- The first customer to open a free table becomes responsible for it and approves who asks to join.
- Prices are those of the menu or of the promotion active when the order is placed, and are recorded on the table's bill.
- Orders go straight to preparation; cancellations and changes depend on the restaurant.
- Online payments are processed by Stripe or Mercado Pago, depending on the restaurant. Anything paid in excess is refunded automatically.
- Items not delivered when the table closes are not charged.

conduct.title: Conduct

restaurants.title: Restaurants
restaurants.body:
- The restaurant answers for the menu, prices, promotions and coupons it offers, for its service and for the information on its public profile.
- The platform's fees on online payments are those of the plan agreed and are shown in the finance panel.
- The restaurant is the controller of the personal data of its service and Table4All processes that data on its behalf to run the service. The restaurant must use it only to serve, charge and meet legal obligations, must not copy it for other purposes or share it without a legal basis, and must forward to Table4All any data subject requests it receives.
- The restaurant answers for the access it gives its staff and must remove it when someone leaves.
- Restaurant accounts are closed by the Table4All team: profile, media and staff access are removed, and financial records are kept for the legal period.

content.title: Posted content
content.body: You still own what you post (pictures, texts, comments and reviews) and grant Table4All a free, non-exclusive licence to display it on the platform while it is posted. You confirm you hold the rights to it.

liability.title: Availability and liability
liability.body: We work to keep the platform stable, including at rush hour, but it may go through maintenance or failures. Nothing in these terms limits the rights granted by Brazil's Consumer Protection Code.

termination.title: Ending the account
termination.body: You can delete your account at any time in Settings > Profile. We may suspend or close accounts that break these terms or the law. Records the law requires us to keep are kept for the legal period, as the Privacy Policy explains.

changes.title: Changes
changes.body: We may update these terms. Relevant changes will be announced in advance by email or on the platform.

law.title: Governing law and contact
law.body: These terms are governed by Brazilian law, and the courts of the consumer's domicile have jurisdiction. Questions: {{dpo_email}}.

hero.title: Full house, tidy floor.
hero.lead: With Table4All guests order from the table's QR code, every order lands in the right kitchen or bar queue, and the bill closes right, split however the table wants. Your staff serves more people and you know how much came in.

cta.primary: I want Table4All in my venue

video.label: Video: Table4All on a packed night

rush.title: Friday, 9 PM. Full house.
rush.body: A raised hand at every table, waiters rushing, orders scribbled in a hurry. This is where sales get lost.

qr.title: Guests order from their phone
qr.body: They scan the table's QR code, see the menu with photos and prices, and send the order. No waiting for anyone.

queue.title: Every order lands in the right queue
queue.body: The draft beer goes to the bar, the snack to the kitchen. Whoever prepares marks it ready, whoever serves marks it delivered.

call.title: One tap and the staff sees it
call.body: Calling the waiter or asking for the bill is a single tap, and it shows up on the floor staff's screen.

pay.title: Split bill, no calculator
pay.body: Everyone pays their share by Pix, card or cash. The table only closes when the bill adds up.

dash.title: You know how much came in
dash.body: Revenue, best sellers and average ticket on the dashboard, updated with every closed table.

loyalty.title: And guests come back
loyalty.body: Loyalty card, coupons and the venue's profile on the feed bring your crowd back.

more_rounds.title: More rounds per table
more_rounds.body: Guests order the next round the moment they feel like it, without waiting for the waiter to pass by. Orders that don't depend on a raised hand happen more often.

no_mistakes.title: No note-taking mistakes
no_mistakes.body: The order goes from the guest's phone straight to the bar or kitchen queue. Nobody rewrites a ticket, nobody mishears.

team.title: Staff at full speed during the rush
team.body: Waiters stop taking notes and start serving, helping and selling. Calls and bill requests show up on the floor staff's screen.

bill.title: Bills that close right
bill.body: The price is locked in when the item is ordered, promotions included. A table only closes when payments cover the total, so nobody leaves owing someone else's share.

control.title: You know how much came in
control.body: Revenue per day, best sellers, average ticket and payment methods, no spreadsheet needed. Check it from anywhere.

return.title: Guests who come back
return.body: Loyalty card, coupons and the venue's profile with posts and stories keep you on your guests' minds and bring them back.

devices.title: Uses what you already have
devices.body: It runs in the browser of the phones, tablets and computers you already use. Guests order on their own phone.

network.title: Built for rush hour
network.body: Designed for weak internet, an old tablet in the kitchen and dozens of orders arriving at once.

everyone.title: Nobody is left out
everyone.body: Guests who don't want to use their phone order from the waiter, who adds it to the same tab from their own phone.

print.title: Printed menu with QR
print.body: The system builds a print-ready menu with the QR code guests use to join the table.

talk.title: A chat
talk.body: Tell us how your venue works: tables, menu, kitchen and bar.

setup.title: Setup
setup.body: We create the venue's account and the menu goes in with photos, prices and prep queues.

tables.title: Tables and staff
tables.body: The QR codes go on the tables and each waiter joins through the invite sent to their email.

night.title: Opening night
night.body: Open the floor. Orders land in the queues and every closed bill shows up on the dashboard.

equipment.q: Do I need to buy any equipment?
equipment.a: No. Table4All runs in the browser of the phones, tablets and computers you already have. In the kitchen, any tablet or screen with internet shows the prep queue.

no_phone.q: What about guests who don't want to order by phone?
no_phone.a: They order from the waiter, as always. The waiter adds the order to the table's tab from their own phone, and it goes to the same queues.

internet.q: Our internet is weak. Will it work?
internet.a: Yes. The system was built for weak 3G and 4G and old devices, and guests use their own mobile data to order.

payments.a: As usual: Pix, card or cash, and the staff records each payment on the tab. If you want, turn on in-app payments and the money goes straight to your Mercado Pago or Stripe account.

cost.a: We agree on the partnership terms in this conversation. On payments guests make through the app, the platform keeps a percentage agreed with you.

data.a: We follow Brazil's LGPD. Other guests and the staff only see the name of whoever is at the table, never their email or phone.

closing.title: Shall we open the first table?
closing.body: Leave your details and we'll arrange the next steps. Or talk right now with the person showing you this page.
